## Preliminaries
```{r}
#Required packages
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

#plotting packages
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)


# PLOTTING COLOURS
northants <- "#444e86"
devon <- "#c1e7ff"
spain <- "#ce4717"
kazakh <- "#25eb81"
swe <- "#ff7730"
gb <- "#444e86"

## PLOTTUGING SHAPES
modern_pch <- 21 # or 19
hist_pch <- 24 # or 17

## IMAGES
library(png)
lsinapis <- readPNG("../metadata/ww.png", native = T)

# METADATA
#read in the modified info while where location for NHM095 and NHM096 is labelled as Northants,
# However, the original museum metadata for lat long are perserved. This is the metda to use for most analysis
infoM <- read_delim(
  "../metadata/WWinfofile_mod_2026.txt",
  delim = ",",
  col_types = cols()
)
#add another variable to this data fram that combines location with time to use as a variable for plotting and analysis
#get theta and new column for plotting
infoM <- infoM %>%
  mutate(
    location_time = str_c(location, Time_hist, sep = "_"),
    Area_time = str_c(Area, Time_hist, sep = "_")
  )
infoM <- infoM %>%
  mutate(
    location_time = factor(
      location_time,
      levels = c(
        "Devon_Historical",
        "Devon_Modern",
        "Northants_Historical",
        "Northants_Modern",
        "Sweden_Modern",
        "Kazakhstan_Modern",
        "Spain_Modern"
      )
    )
  )

```

## Angsd PCA

```{r}
Covmat <- as.matrix(read.table(
  "../results/structure/pca/all.DTOLREF.dedup.sitefilt.bQ20.mq30.dpInd3-30.minInd0.9.maf0.05.pv1e-6.maxkb4000.rndsample1.0.prunebp50000.minr20.1.excl-LsSpa8-M8.cov"
))
eig <- eigen(Covmat)

#order of individuals as prepared for beagle file
#any excluded invididuals i.e. due to relatdness have been removed
angsPCAids <- read.table("../results/structure/pca/angsdPCA_ind_ids")

#Make character vector for label for PCs
PCnames <- vector()
for (i in 1:dim(eig$vectors)[1]) {
  PCnames <- c(PCnames, c(paste0("PC", i)))
}

#add names to columns of eigenvectos
eigenvecs <- cbind(angsPCAids, eig$vectors)
names(eigenvecs) <- c("sample_name", PCnames)

#Combine eigenvector with full sample data
PCAdf <- inner_join(
  eigenvecs,
  infoM,
  by = c("sample_name" = "short_specimen_name")
)

#caluclate variance explained by PC1,2,3
pc1 <- round(eig$values[1] / sum(eig$values) * 100, 1)
pc2 <- round(eig$values[2] / sum(eig$values) * 100, 1)
pc3 <- round(eig$values[3] / sum(eig$values) * 100, 1)

PCPlotPC1_2 <- PCAdf %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = PC2,
    fill = location,
    pch = Time_hist,
    label = sample_name
  )) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.6, color = "black", position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(devon, kazakh, northants, spain, swe),
    name = "Location:"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(hist_pch, modern_pch),
    name = "Collection Period:"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = PCAdf %>% filter(sample_name %in% c("NHM095", "NHM096")),
    aes(label = "  *"),
    col = "gray40",
    size = 8,
    fontface = "bold",
    position = position_nudge(x = .00, y = 0.001)
  ) +
  # geom_label_repel(
  #   nudge_x = 0.25, nudge_y = 0.25,
  #   check_overlap = T
  # ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(pch = 21))) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 ", pc1, "%")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 ", pc2, "%")) +
  ggtitle("A") +
  #geom_rect(aes(xmin = -.28, xmax = -.15, ymin = 0.05, ymax = .12), color = "black", fill = #NA,  linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.5) +
  #geom_segment(aes(x = -.28, y = .05, xend = -.33, yend = .03), color="black") +
  #geom_segment(aes(x = -.15, y = .05, xend = -.065, yend = .03), color="black") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = grid::unit(c(1, 5, 1, 1), "mm"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "mm"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(-15, -15, -15, -15)
  )

PCPlotPC2_3 <- PCAdf %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = PC2,
    y = PC3,
    fill = location,
    pch = Time_hist,
    label = sample_name
  )) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.6, color = "black", position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(devon, kazakh, northants, spain, swe),
    name = "Location:"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(hist_pch, modern_pch),
    name = "Collection Period:"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = PCAdf %>% filter(sample_name %in% c("NHM095", "NHM096")),
    aes(label = "  *"),
    col = "gray40",
    size = 8,
    fontface = "bold",
    position = position_nudge(x = .00, y = 0.001)
  ) +
  # geom_label_repel(
  #   nudge_x = 0.25, nudge_y = 0.25,
  #   check_overlap = T
  # ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(pch = 21))) +
  xlab(paste0("PC2 ", pc2, "%")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC3 ", pc3, "%")) +
  ggtitle("B") +
  #geom_rect(aes(xmin = -.28, xmax = -.15, ymin = 0.05, ymax = .12), color = "black", fill = #NA,  linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.5) +
  #geom_segment(aes(x = -.28, y = .05, xend = -.33, yend = .03), color="black") +
  #geom_segment(aes(x = -.15, y = .05, xend = -.065, yend = .03), color="black") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = grid::unit(c(1, 5, 1, 1), "mm"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "mm"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(-15, -15, -15, -15)
  )
```

## Individual heterozygosity
```{r}
hets0_1 <- read.table(
  "../results/diversity_stats/notrans/heterozygosity/merged.all.DTOLREF.sitefilt.bQ20.mq30.snps5.noIndel.Q30.dp6-30.AB.jointCall.notrans.allsites.fmiss0.1.bcf.stats.het",
  header = T
)

#combine het data with metadata
HETdf <- inner_join(
  hets0_1,
  infoM,
  by = c("sample" = "short_specimen_name")
)

#Hets by group
hetGroup <- HETdf %>%
ggplot(aes(x = location_time, y = hetperbp * 1000, fill = location_time)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.y = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 6,
    aes(fill = location_time, pch = Time_hist)
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(
      x = location_time,
      y = hetperbp * 1000,
      pch = Time_hist,
      fill = location_time
    ),
    size = 2,
    height = 0,
    width = 0.3
  ) +
  # geom_dotplot(binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center", aes(fill=location_time,pch=Time_hist  ),  dotsize = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(devon, devon, northants, northants, swe, kazakh, spain),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("DEVH", "DEV", "NTHH", "NTH", "SWE", "KAZ", "SPA")
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(hist_pch, modern_pch), guide = "none") +
  ylab("Heterozygotes/1000 basepairs") +
  ggtitle("A") +
  # annotate(geom="segment", x = 3, xend = 4, y = 1.2, yend = 1.2, color = "black", fill = NA, linetype="solid", linewidth=1, lineend="butt") + #add annotation from test results
  #annotate("text", x = 3.5, y = 1.22, label = expression(italic(p)*" = 0.018"), face="bold", size=3.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    ),
    plot.margin = grid::unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "mm"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )

#GBP hets by time

HetTime <- HETdf %>%
    filter(Area == "GB") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=year, y=hetperbp*1000))+
    geom_point(aes(fill=location),pch=21,size=3)+
    scale_fill_manual( values = c(devon,  northants), guide = "none")+
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    ),
    plot.margin = grid::unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "mm"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )


```

## RoH from bcttools
```{r}
#get size of autosomale genome
genome <- read.table(
  "../../ref_genome/Leptidea_sinapis-GCA_905404315.1-softmasked.genome",
  header = F
)
#calculate autosomal genome size
autoGen <- sum(genome$V2[!genome$V1 %in% c("Z", "2", "3")])


#read in roh regions output from bcftools
roh_regs <- read.delim(
  "../results/roh/bcftools/notrans/merged.all.DTOLREF.sitefilt.bQ20.mq30.snps5.noIndel.Q30.dp6-30.AB.jointCall.notrans.biallelic.fmiss0.1.roh.M7.4e-8.regs.txt",
  comment.char = "#"
)

#add col names
names(roh_regs) <- c(
  "RG",
  "Sample",
  "Chromosome",
  "Start",
  "End",
  "Length_bp",
  "Number of markers",
  "Quality"
)

#filter out non GB samples
roh_filtered <- roh_regs %>% filter(!startsWith(Sample, "Ls"))

#Calculate Froh in regions greater than 100 kb
roh_gr100Kb <- roh_filtered %>%
  filter(Length_bp >= 100000) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(rohP100 = sum(Length_bp) / autoGen, num_roh=n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  #complete(Sample, fill = list(rohP100 = NA)) %>%
  mutate(rohP100 = replace_na(rohP100, 0))

```
